newsitem.title: USA: Salomon cuts Mexico, ups Chile in model portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Salomon cuts Mexico, ups Chile in model portfolio.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it had increased Chile's weighting by two percent in its model Latin American stock portfolio and reduced Mexico's by two percent.
In a March 11 statement, Salomon said the move "narrows our underweight position in Chile and takes us from an overweight position in Mexico to a modest underweight position."

The change was made March 4 and underscored analyst Gilbert Casillas's "more positive view of the Chilean electric utilities, as well as our view that a further central bank interest rate cut is at hand."
The change in Mexico was made because of concerns about both U.S. and Mexican interest rates.
